errors.constraintEmpty: Constraint {n}: enter a number, a reference or a formula for the constraint
errors.constraintKind: Constraint {n}: {kind, select, dif {all-different} bin {binary} other {integer}} constraints apply to variable cells only
errors.constraintRange: Constraint {n}: enter its cell reference as one range on this sheet
errors.constraintRhs: Constraint {n}: the right side is not a number, a reference or a formula
errors.constraintSize: Constraint {n}: the right side must be one cell or a range the size of the left side
errors.locked: The sheet is protected and some variable cells are locked
errors.objectiveCell: Enter one cell on this sheet for the objective, like $B$10
errors.objectiveFormula: The objective cell must hold a formula that depends on the variable cells
errors.tooMany: A model can have at most {max} variable cells
errors.value: Enter the number the objective should reach
errors.variableFormula: The variable cell {cell} holds a formula; variable cells must hold numbers or be blank
errors.variableSpill: The variable cell {cell} shows part of an array formula's result
errors.variableText: The variable cell {cell} holds text; variable cells must hold numbers or be blank
errors.variables: Enter the variable cells as ranges on this sheet, like $B$2:$B$5 or $B$2,$D$2
load.badConstraint: The constraint in cell {n} of the range is not one Save Model writes
load.noCount: The second cell must count the variable cells, as =COUNT(…)
load.noObjective: The first cell must hold the objective, as Save Model writes it (=MAX(…), =MIN(…) or =cell=value)
result.converged: Solver converged on the current solution. All constraints are met.
result.error: A trial value made a formula in the model fail (an error, or text where a number was expected).
result.evoConverged: Solver converged on this solution, which is likely near the best one. All constraints are met.
result.feasibleLimit: Solving reached the limit on integer solutions. The best solution found so far is shown.
result.infeasible: Solver could not find a solution that meets all the constraints.
result.iterationLimit: Solving reached the iteration limit. The best solution found so far is shown.
result.localOptimal: Solver found a locally optimal solution. All constraints and optimality conditions are met.
result.needsBounds: The Evolutionary method needs a lower and an upper bound on every variable cell. Add them as constraints, or clear Require Bounds on Variables in Options.
result.noImprovement: Solver could not improve on the current solution. All constraints are met.
result.nodeLimit: Solving reached the limit on subproblems. The best solution found so far is shown.
result.notLinear: This model is not linear, so Simplex LP cannot solve it. Choose GRG Nonlinear or Evolutionary.
result.notNumber: The objective cell does not hold a number.
result.optimal: Solver found a solution. All constraints and optimality conditions are met.
result.optimalInteger: Solver found an integer solution within the integer optimality tolerance. All constraints are met.
result.stopped: Solving was stopped. The best solution found so far is shown.
result.timeLimit: Solving reached the time limit. The best solution found so far is shown.
result.unbounded: The objective can grow without limit. Add constraints or bounds on the variable cells.
